name: The Green O
positioning: All-inclusive retreat for adults: a small collection of design-led woodland hauses with private hot tubs, set apart within the Paws Up property in Montana
best_for: Couples wanting a private, all-inclusive woodland stay for two
Travelers who want a design-led haus with a private hot tub plus access to the full Paws Up property

facts.text: The Green O is a retreat for adults, set apart from the main Paws Up resort.
Its hauses come in four styles that blend indoor-outdoor living with forest views.
Each haus includes floor-to-ceiling windows, an eco-kitchenette, a private outdoor hot tub and a Lexus SUV to drive on the property.
The Tree Haus has a spiral staircase leading to a master bedroom suite.
The Round Haus has a sunken living room with a two-sided fireplace.
The Green Haus has a glass-encased living room.
The Green Haus is a dog-friendly accommodation.
Green O guests have exclusive access to the Social Haus restaurant, which serves eight-course meals.
Haus stays include gourmet meals, snacks, airport transfers from and to Missoula International Airport, and access to resort amenities such as the 24/7 gym.
Stays include private access to 100 miles of trails and 10 miles of the Blackfoot River.

highlights.text: The Tree Haus is perched 23 feet above the ground, with floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Round Haus has curved floor-to-ceiling windows with 180-degree panoramic views of the Montana wilderness.
The Light Haus has a glass bump-out design for viewing the night sky.
Green O guests have access to the full Paws Up property, including its 37,000 acres and wide range of activities.
The Romance Package features three nights in a Green O haus, nightly dinners, a private trail ride and a wellness session.

considerations.text: The Green O is for adults, and each haus sleeps two guests.
The included Lexus SUV is for driving on the property.
WhataHotel notes the remote location may require additional travel planning.
